learning_outcomes.text: Mature knowledge on the operating characteristics of turbomachinery.
Apply the law of energy conservation to individual devices and complex systems.
Demonstrate competence to specify characteristics in energy systems starting from the characteristics of individual components.
Acquire knowledge and understand phenomena underlying the operation of energy conversion systems.

syllabus_topics: THERMODYNAMICS: Fluid properties, energy conservation equations, adiabatic compression and expansion transformations.
Efficiency of machines and energy systems.
Work exchange between fluid and moving parts in turbomachinery.
Axial flow turbines, stages, degree of reaction, blading efficiency.
PUMPS AND COMPRESSORS: Definition of head.
Power and efficiency, off-design operating conditions.
Plant diagrams and methods to increase efficiency.
Conditions for maximum work and maximum efficiency.
Limits on maximum turbine inlet temperature.
assessment_rules: The oral exam is aimed at assessing the acquisition of learning objectives, integrated with numerical applications. The final evaluation is based on a final grade.
degree: Laurea in Ingegneria Industriale (Industrial Engineering), classe L-9 Classe delle lauree in Ingegneria industriale
